eligibility: next response due time is earlier than the evaluation time
the current owner is Support Triage or Nina Patel
no executive page or expedited replacement is already active
the complete history contains no later customer recovery confirmation

automation_dependencies.condition: priority becomes 3 high in Support Triage

change_policy: Update only tickets that satisfy every eligibility condition. Leave every other state, priority, owner, and workflow unchanged.
audit_note: Record the evaluated due time, ownership check, and absence of an existing escalation as an internal note on each ticket whose priority changes.
